profile.own_vehicle_pattern: ^(lux ventures|lux capital management|lux co-invest|lux health tech acquisition|lux defense leaders|lux total opportunities|pioneer pier investments)
profile._note: Lux's live site groups companies under its own three-word industry phrases ('Engineering + Electronics', 'Physics + Aerospace', 'Securing Life + Environment'); the 2005 and 2012 sites used plain sector words (Energy / Technology / Healthcare, Semiconductors, Biotechnology, Aerospace, Defense). Both vocabularies are crosswalked here and the phrases are also split into single words by the profile's focus recompute (COLLECTION.md §11, the comma-joined-tags rule). focus_min_companies ~4.5% of an expected ~270-row base. The site's own tags carry non-breaking spaces and inconsistent capitalisation between cards ('Increasing Productivity +\u00a0Efficiency', 'Biology biochemistry', 'infrastructure computer science'), so the crosswalk carries the exact variants as well as the canonical phrases and the single words the §11 recompute splits them into.

shape._note: decisions.md: a 2000-vintage deep-tech firm whose live site is a 215-row curated list and whose winners are unusually large (Anduril, Applied Intuition, Databricks, Hugging Face, Ramp, Physical Intelligence, Anthropic-adjacent infra), so the $1B+ share is expected above the 20% megafund default; the guard still fires above 30%. S2A ceiling restated 2026-09-17 under the status contract (D-S2A in decisions.md): 130 seed entries, 9 censored, 94 undetermined, cohort 27 at 88.9% with 22% coverage. The binding constraint on this book is the entry-stage leg, not the graduation: only 25 of 133 rows arrive with a verified stage, and Lux's announcement surface is a newsletter rather than a deal blog, so a seed round naming Lux is usually unciteable even where the later round is well documented. What survives is a 27-row remnant of well-covered companies, which is why the rate sits high on very thin coverage. Restated to 0.90; the guard still fires above that, and the coverage is published beside the rate. S2A re-measured 2026-09-20 under PRO-132, where every Seed row is decided (coverage 100% by construction): 39 seed entries, 3 censored, cohort 36 at 83.3%. PRO-135 left only 39 Seed rows (137 nameable rows read an undetermined stage), and what remains are well-covered winners whose seeds Lux announced; the rate stays above the 0.80 default on the full, decided seed book, so the 0.90 ceiling stands.
